requirements.summary: Create exactly 3 navigable screens with mobile-responsive layout, animated fade/slide transitions, and correct Previous/Next controls per page.
acceptanceCriteria: There are exactly 3 distinct pages/screens with route-based navigation (or equivalent) and animated transitions between them.
Page 1 does not show a “Previous Page” button.
Page 2 shows “Previous Page” and “Next Page” buttons.
Page 3 shows a “Previous Page” button; Page 3 does not require a “Next Page” button.
Layout adapts cleanly to common mobile widths (e.g., 360px) without overflowing text/buttons.

file_operations.description: Implement the 3-screen navigation controller using hash-based navigation (or equivalent) with a shared layout wrapper and page transition orchestration (fade/slide) between Page 1, Page 2, and Page 3.
Create Page 1 screen component with only the allowed navigation control behavior (no Previous; Next hidden until unlocked) and integrate with the app-level navigation API.
Create Page 2 screen component with always-visible Previous and Next buttons wired to app navigation.
Create Page 3 screen component with always-visible Previous button wired to app navigation; omit Next button.

Add a reusable navigation controls component that enforces per-page button visibility rules and supports mobile-friendly sizing/tap targets. Use the shadcn-ui component set (e.g., its Button styles) for consistent controls; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Apply consistent global design: pink/peach/warm-golden gradients, rounded modern typography, deep black text, subtle sparkles/balloons where needed, and confetti only during celebration moments.
acceptanceCriteria: All pages use gradient backgrounds in the specified palette and maintain high readability with deep black text.
Typography uses a rounded, modern style across headings/body and remains consistent between pages.
Sparkles are subtle and do not impair readability.
Confetti appears only on (a) Page 1 reveal click and (b) Page 3 gentle fall after the specified delay; no constant confetti background effect.

file_operations.description: Define global typography (rounded modern fallback stack), deep-black readable text defaults, gradient background utility classes, and shared animation keyframes (fade/slide transitions, subtle sparkle drift).
Extend Tailwind theme with the birthday gradient palette and custom keyframes/animations needed for fade/slide transitions, balloon float, sparkle shimmer, petal fall, and gentle glow accents.

Implement reusable decorative background layers (gradient base + subtle sparkles overlay) that can be toggled per page and parameterized for Page 1 vs Page 3 themes. Use the generated sprite asset frontend/public/assets/generated/sparkles-sprites.dim_512x512.png for subtle sparkles; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Implement an event-driven confetti overlay component (no continuous loop), with APIs to trigger a burst (Page 1) and a gentle timed fall (Page 3), ensuring it ends automatically.

requirements.summary: Build Page 1 with timed text swap, floating balloons background, reveal button that triggers confetti + glow, then shows birthday message and unlocks Next Page.
acceptanceCriteria: On Page 1 load, the first text is visible; at ~2 seconds it transitions (fade) to the second text.
Balloons animate upward continuously and subtly in the background.
Clicking “Reveal the Birthday Girl 👀” triggers a noticeable confetti burst and a short-lived glow overlay/animation.
After clicking, the birthday message appears and a “Next Page” button becomes visible and usable.
Confetti on Page 1 does not loop continuously; it is an event-based burst.

file_operations.description: Implement Page 1 content and behaviors: initial centered text, automatic fade-to-second-text at ~2s, large “Reveal the Birthday Girl 👀” action, on-click confetti burst + brief glow overlay, then reveal the birthday message and show the “Next Page” button.

Create a background balloons layer that continuously and subtly moves upward behind Page 1 content using the static asset frontend/public/assets/generated/balloon-single.dim_512x512.png (multiple instances with varied positions/scales).
Add a short-lived full-screen glow overlay/animation that Page 1 triggers after the reveal click (pink/peach glow) without blocking navigation after it ends.
Add a dedicated 'burst' trigger mode suitable for Page 1 (high-energy but brief) and ensure it never loops or persists as a background effect.
Ensure Page 1 wiring supports the 'locked' state: no Previous button; Next button remains hidden until Page 1 is unlocked.

requirements.summary: Add opt-in background instrumental music on Page 1 with a small play/pause control and no autoplay.
acceptanceCriteria: A play/pause control is available on Page 1 to enable/disable background music.
Music is not audible until the user explicitly starts playback.
Playback can be paused/stopped by the user.

file_operations.description: Add a bundled instrumental birthday music track to be used only as opt-in background audio (no autoplay).

Implement a small unobtrusive play/pause control (with accessible labeling) that manages a single HTMLAudioElement and never starts playback until user interaction. Use shadcn-ui button styling (or equivalent) for the control; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire the AudioToggle into Page 1 layout and ensure audio defaults to paused on initial load; keep control unobtrusive and mobile-safe.

requirements.summary: Build Page 2 with the provided exact report text, playful newspaper/board aesthetic, and a flowers button that reveals an animated panda/kitten-with-flowers plus message; include Previous/Next navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Page 2 displays the title and all specified lines/sections exactly as provided, including “Name: batak”.
The page styling reads like a playful newspaper/board (e.g., paper card, subtle grain, pinned-note feel, or animated accents).
Clicking “Accept Birthday Flowers 🌷” reveals the panda/kitten-with-flowers visual and plays a simple “pop-in”/bounce animation.
After clicking the button, the message “Today, you don’t chase goals. You receive flowers.” is visible under the visual.
“Previous Page” and “Next Page” navigation is visible and functional.

file_operations.description: Implement Page 2 layout and exact text content (including Charges bullets and Verdict/Punishment lines) with a cute animated newspaper/celebration-board aesthetic and visible Previous/Next navigation.

Create a reusable 'paper/card' component with subtle grain/pinned-note accents and gentle motion cues for the Page 2 report presentation. Use shadcn-ui card-like primitives/styling where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement the “Accept Birthday Flowers 🌷” interaction: on click, reveal the image frontend/public/assets/generated/panda-flowers.dim_768x768.png with a pop-in/bounce animation and then show the message “Today, you don’t chase goals.\nYou receive flowers.”
Ensure Page 2 always renders both Previous and Next buttons, with consistent sizing and placement across mobile widths.

requirements.summary: Build Page 3 with warm golden-pink glow, falling petals animation, timed gentle confetti fall after 3 seconds, provided wish text with bullets, “The End”, and Previous navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Flower petals continuously fall in a subtle loop behind the text without harming readability.
At ~3 seconds after Page 3 becomes visible, a gentle confetti fall starts and then ends (not infinite).
All provided text appears on Page 3 with line breaks and bullet list formatting preserved for readability.
A softly glowing “The End” text is visible at the end of the content.
A visible “Previous Page” button navigates back to Page 2.

file_operations.description: Implement Page 3 content with the provided multi-paragraph wish text (preserving line breaks and bullet list), final line, and softly glowing “The End” text; include visible Previous navigation back to Page 2.
Create a subtle looping falling-petals background animation using the sprite set frontend/public/assets/generated/petals-sprites.dim_512x512.png, ensuring readability and performance on mobile.
Add a 'gentle fall' mode suitable for Page 3 and a timer-based trigger API so Page 3 can start confetti ~3 seconds after the page becomes visible and stop automatically.
Ensure Page 3 renders only a Previous button (no Next required) and maintains consistent placement across screen sizes.

requirements.summary: Bundle and wire generated static image assets for the panda-with-flowers reveal and sparkle/petal/balloon sprites; load all visuals from frontend static assets only.
acceptanceCriteria: The panda/kitten holding flowers uses a bundled static image (or images) served from the frontend (e.g., under frontend/public/assets/generated).
If sprites are used for sparkles/petals, they are bundled as static assets and render correctly on all pages.
No backend calls are required for displaying these visuals.

file_operations.description: Add the generated panda-with-flowers static image asset for Page 2 reveal.
Add the generated sparkle sprite set for subtle sparkle effects.
Add the generated petal sprite set for Page 3 falling petals animation.
Add the generated single balloon illustration to be instanced for Page 1 floating balloons.
Wire sparkle sprites from frontend/public/assets/generated/sparkles-sprites.dim_512x512.png into the subtle sparkle layer; ensure the effect remains subtle and readable.
Wire petals sprites from frontend/public/assets/generated/petals-sprites.dim_512x512.png into the falling petal animation.
Wire the balloon asset frontend/public/assets/generated/balloon-single.dim_512x512.png into the floating balloons layer and confirm it renders correctly on all pages (where used).
Ensure the reveal uses frontend/public/assets/generated/panda-flowers.dim_768x768.png and does not perform any backend calls for visuals.
